description: The pie chart represents the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which includes twelve distinct categories. The largest category is 'AI/NLP Research,' making up 24.3% of the dataset, followed by 'Econ. & Fin.' at 18.4%. 'History' and 'Game&Anime' are tied at 8.2%, while 'Daily Life' constitutes 7.1%. 'Med & Health' and 'Science' both represent 6.7%, with 'Business' slightly lower at 5.9%. 'Pet & Animal' and 'Law' are close in proportion, at 5.5% and 5.1%, respectively. 'Geography' and 'Math' are the smallest categories, with 'Geography' at 3.7% and 'Math' at 2.2%. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered by size, with 'AI/NLP Research' being the largest and 'Math' being the smallest.
